title: Use `LocalVector` for code completion filtering

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

In certain cases code completion can take some time to show up.

Changed all Vectors that I could to LocalVector. and all Lists.
Changed CodeCompletionOption's characteristics TypedArray to FixedVector, it only holds 5 ints. (This had the largest performance impact).
Used const for iterating in some places.
Also cleaned up the surrounding code a bit.
The logic should not be any different.

To check performance I made a script with many functions of the same character `a` of different lengths, and tested the time it takes for `CodeEdit::_filter_code_completion_candidates_impl` to run after querying completion on different lengths of `a` 

Performance results (dev build for both, avg over 3 queries, microseconds)
query | before | after
-- | -- | --
`aa` | 117,051 | 81,137
`aaa` | 462,743 | 195,016
`aaaa` | 3,803,037 | 1,570,754
`aaaaa` | 28,721,674 | 11,935,447

There are more savings the longer the completion query is.
The test was somewhat arbitrary, but I don't think this will have a negative impact anywhere.
I think this scenario is a kind of worst case where it needs to check many potential matches. The times can still get pretty long, but I would need to be more familiar with the logic if we want optimize it more.


## Additional information

I had to re-implement the sorting that Array had, but its pretty straightforward.
